query:
insert into ticket_designs (id, event_id, version, spec, art_blob_id, sponsor_blob_ids, photo_blob_ids,
                                      stub_image_blob_id)
           values ($1, $2, (select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 from ticket_designs where event_id = $2), $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
           returning version
